ask.label: 询问
ask.description: 敏感操作前等待用户确认。

readonly.label: 只读
readonly.description: 允许读取与分析，禁止写入和执行变更。

full.label: 完全访问
full.description: WARNING: grants broad auto-approval for most agent tools. High-risk host process / network / HTTP / shell tool classes still require explicit confirmation where the runtime honors toolApprovalOverrides. Prefer ask unless you trust the session.

free.label: 自由实现
free.description: WARNING: historically advertised as auto-approve everything after ~8s for interactive prompts. It is NOT a network/process free-for-all — high-risk process/network/HTTP/shell tools require approval (requireApproval + toolApprovalOverrides). Prefer ask for untrusted workspaces.

full.warning: full_access does not waive high-risk host process/network/HTTP/shell confirmation.

free.warning: free must not be treated as auto-approve for process/network/HTTP/shell tools.
